prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic smartphone screenshot of a Xiaohongshu-style post featuring a simple two-panel hand-drawn comic about a tired young man trying outdoor activities, with engagement metrics circled in red.

Canvas: Vertical mobile screenshot, 9:16 aspect ratio, white app interface, iPhone-like status bar at the top showing 08:34, signal bars, “4G”, and a battery icon.

Top app header: Show a back arrow on the left, a small circular avatar, the username 水枪装尿呲谁谁叫, a rounded pink-outline follow button labeled “关注”, and a share arrow icon on the right.

Main post image: A large white comic card with a thick black rectangular border, divided into exactly 2 stacked panels by one horizontal black divider. Add a small gray rounded page indicator in the top-right corner of the comic card reading “2/11”. Use loose black ink line art with muted watercolor fills, casual sketch style, lots of white space.

Comic panel 1: At the top left, handwritten red-and-black Chinese text reads 逛洗浴、露营,. In the center, draw a slim tired young man with short messy black hair, pale face, droopy eyes, dark green jacket, gray shirt, and dark pants, hands in pockets. Around him place exactly 3 simple activity icons: a steaming bath tub on the left, a hanging towel at lower left, and a camping tent on the right.

Comic panel 2: At the top left, handwritten red-and-black Chinese text reads 钓鱼、爬山……. Draw the same tired young man centered slightly right, holding a fishing rod in one hand with the line and hook hanging down, the other hand in his pocket. Around him place exactly 3 simple outdoor icons: mountains with a tiny cloud at upper left, the fishing rod and hook extending from his hand toward the left, and a backpack on the right.

Below the comic: Add a carousel dot indicator with exactly 4 dots, the second dot red and the other 3 gray. Then show the bold caption 这日子真是越过越有盼头. Below it, show exactly 5 hashtag phrases in blue-gray Chinese: “#漫画”, “#当漫画照进生活”, “#原创漫画”, “#突然的绷不住”, “#每天一个治愈小漫画”. Add a rounded search suggestion bar with a magnifying glass icon and Chinese text beginning with “猜你想搜｜日子过得越来越有盼头了”.

Bottom interaction area: Add a pale comment input pill on the left with a pencil icon and placeholder “说点什么...”. On the right, show exactly 3 interaction icons with counts: a heart icon with 1703, a star icon with “408”, and a comment bubble icon with “1003”. Draw a thick freehand red circle around these three engagement metrics, as if marked with a digital pen.

Visual style and constraints: Keep the screenshot clean and realistic, with crisp UI elements and a slightly imperfect hand-drawn comic. Use black, white, muted green, gray, pale pink, and red accents. Preserve all visible Chinese UI text exactly where specified. Do not add extra panels, extra icons, watermarks, or unrelated decorations.

promptZh:
目标：创建一张逼真的小红书风格帖子手机截图，内容为一张简单的两格手绘漫画，讲述一名疲惫的年轻人尝试户外活动，并用红色圈出互动数据。

画布：竖屏手机截图，9:16 比例，白色 App 界面，顶部显示类似 iPhone 的状态栏，时间为 08:34，包含信号栏、“4G”图标和电池图标。

App 顶部标题栏：左侧显示返回箭头，一个小圆形头像，用户名 水枪装尿呲谁谁叫，一个带有粉色边框的圆角“关注”按钮，右侧显示分享箭头图标。

帖子主图：一张大的白色漫画卡片，带有粗黑色矩形边框，由一条水平黑色分隔线分为上下 2 格。在漫画卡片右上角添加一个小的灰色圆角页面指示器，显示“2/11”。使用随性的黑色墨水线条，填充柔和的水彩，草图风格，留白较多。

漫画第 1 格：左上角手写红黑配色的中文文本 逛洗浴、露营，。中间绘制一名瘦削疲惫的年轻人，短乱黑发，脸色苍白，眼神下垂，身穿深绿色夹克、灰色衬衫和深色裤子，双手插兜。在他周围放置 3 个简单的活动图标：左侧是一个冒热气的浴缸，左下方是一条挂着的毛巾，右侧是一个露营帐篷。

漫画第 2 格：左上角手写红黑配色的中文文本 钓鱼、爬山……。绘制同样的疲惫年轻人，位置略偏右，一只手拿着鱼竿，鱼线和鱼钩垂下，另一只手插在兜里。在他周围放置 3 个简单的户外图标：左上方是带有小云朵的山峰，鱼竿和鱼钩从他手中向左延伸，右侧是一个背包。

漫画下方：添加一个轮播点指示器，共 4 个点，第 2 个点为红色，其余 3 个为灰色。下方显示加粗标题 这日子真是越过越有盼头。下方显示 5 个蓝灰色中文标签：“#漫画”、“#当漫画照进生活”、“#原创漫画”、“#突然的绷不住”、“#每天一个治愈小漫画”。添加一个圆角搜索建议栏，包含放大镜图标和以“猜你想搜｜日子过得越来越有盼头了”开头的中文文本。

底部互动区：左侧添加一个浅色评论输入框，带有铅笔图标和占位符“说点什么...”。右侧显示 3 个带有数值的互动图标：爱心图标显示 1703，星星图标显示“408”，评论气泡图标显示“1003”。用粗手绘红圈圈住这三个互动数据，模拟数码笔标记效果。

视觉风格与限制：保持截图整洁逼真，UI 元素清晰，手绘漫画略带不完美感。使用黑色、白色、柔和的绿色、灰色、浅粉色和红色作为点缀。严格保留所有指定的中文 UI 文本。不要添加额外的面板、图标、水印或不相关的装饰。
